answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops a sybil flood at the gate. To claim a slot, an agent burns 0.05 POA that is never refunded, like pigment mixed into paint that cannot be separated again. One honest agent pays just 0.05 POA for its one slot. An attacker trying to forge 1000 fake identities must burn 1000 x 0.05 = 50 POA up front, and each extra slot costs another 0.05, so the bill grows linearly. No echo of one payment across identities: every slot needs its own burn, and honest slots earn real work undiluted by fakes.
